tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. The anchor surface; near-black with a faint blue tint. Never swap for pure #000.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Default cards, panels, sprint board columns. One step above canvas.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Featured or hovered cards, selected tab, badge fill.

tokens.name: surface-4
tokens.usage: Deepest lifted surface (popover inside a menu).

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger 1px borders: hovered cards, input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas and surface-1..4.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta info, badge text.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: unselected tabs, footer links, 'To Do' status.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and footnotes only. 3.6:1 on canvas, below 4.5:1: never for readable body text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, focus ring, brand mark. As TEXT on surface-1 it is only 4.0:1, so links and small accent text use primary-hover. Never a section fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on primary. White on primary is about 4.6:1.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of the primary button; also link and small accent text on dark surfaces (6.6:1 on surface-1).

tokens.name: primary-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, 50% opacity) and pressed primary button.

tokens.name: brand-secure
tokens.usage: Muted lavender-gray for secondary brand moments.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: 'Done' status, income amounts, success messages. The only semantic colour in the source.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ADDED for SmartCash (not in source): expenses, errors, blocked issues, overspent budget.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: ADDED for SmartCash (not in source): 'In Progress' status, budget near limit. Orange, not yellow, so it is told apart from success by lightness too.

families.sans: Inter, "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Largest hero or sprint-review title slide.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card body, list rows, nav links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrow; the only positive tracking.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Issue keys (SC-42), amounts in tables, code.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between blocks in a panel.
